table_title: List the Summer Olympic Games hosted between 1960 and 2020 (inclusive), with the host city, host country, continent, and number of participating nations.
db_analog: SELECT year, host_city, host_country, continent, participating_nations FROM summer_olympic_games WHERE year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020 ORDER BY year
temporal_note: Wikipedia per-edition Summer Olympics articles accessed 2026-04-30. The temporal filter (year BETWEEN 1960 AND 2020) yields 16 Summer Olympic Games editions held every four years. Tokyo 2020 was held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic but retains its 'Tokyo 2020' official IOC designation; the staged Year column uses 2020 (the IOC-official designation) per the master Wikipedia article's convention. Host country names use the politically-current name at the time of the Games: 'West Germany' for the 1972 Munich Games (Germany was politically divided 1949-1990); 'Soviet Union' for the 1980 Moscow Games (USSR existed 1922-1991). All facts are stable historical records and will not drift over time.
_extraction_notes: Universe: 16 Summer Olympic Games editions held every 4 years between 1960 and 2020 inclusive (1960, 1964, 1968, 1972, 1976, 1980, 1984, 1988, 1992, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020). Anchored to Wikipedia 'Summer Olympic Games' master article which lists all editions; each per-edition row's Participating Nations value comes from that edition's Wikipedia article (per-row citation from cycle 0 — applies the cycles 1+2+3 lessons from prior instances where audit-driven citation expansion was needed). Schema is straightforward filter+projection with no per-partition K-selection: Year is the load-bearing entity key (one Summer Olympics per year in the staged range). Tokyo 2020 row uses Year=2020 per IOC-official 'Tokyo 2020' designation even though the Games were physically held in 2021 due to COVID-19. Host Country uses the politically-current name at the time: West Germany for 1972 Munich, Soviet Union for 1980 Moscow. Continent column uses the standard 7-continent classification (the staged data covers 5 continents — Europe, Asia, North America, Oceania, South America — Africa and Antarctica are absent because no Summer Olympics has been held on those continents in the 1960-2020 range). Participating Nations is the article-stated count of NOCs that competed (where infobox and body counts differ — 1964 Tokyo and 1988 Seoul — the staged value uses the actually-competed count: 93 for Tokyo where Libya withdrew, 159 for Seoul where 1 NOC entered but did not compete). Result: 16 rows × 5 columns, PK on Year is unique, 0 duplicates.
